verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API. Its chat and Responses APIs take natural-language prompts, but that is the service it sells, not a way to operate the product itself, so it earns no credit here. The only relevant evidence is a probe noting an official MCP server documented at console.groq.com/docs/mcp. That would let an AI agent drive Groq through natural language, but nothing shows which operations it exposes. missing for 10: documented natural-language control of account, key, billing, batch or model management; detail on what the official MCP server can do; any hands-on or independent corroboration.
